visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a pink cap, a navy and white block-patterned jacket, and white joggers walks toward the camera on a grey-tiled urban sidewalk. He smiles broadly with wide eyes, looking surprised and energetic. Motorbikes are parked on the left, and an orange Kerry Logistics truck is in the background. (2) The man stands near a large stone planter with shrubs in front of a grey building. He leans against a metallic post and transitions through playful poses: a shushing gesture, a prayer-like hand clasp, and a comedic arm flex while grinning at the lens. (3) In a cramped indoor kitchen or storage area with exposed brick walls, the man stands behind a metal wire rack. He looks at the camera with a focused, playful expression before quickly ducking out of frame to the right. (4) The man walks through a brightly lit retail shop filled with hanging bags and accessories. He waves casually to the camera with his right hand as he moves past the aisles, appearing relaxed and friendly. (5) Inside a moving public bus, the man wears purple-tinted sunglasses and mimics a massive, exaggerated yawn while clutching a handrail. He then removes the glasses, smiles warmly with squinted eyes, and hugs the vertical pole with both arms. (6) Back in a lifestyle boutique with wooden shelving and decorative clocks, the man walks through the aisles. He notices the camera and flashes a double 'rock on' hand sign followed by a thumbs-up while smiling brightly. (7) Outdoors on a sidewalk next to a road with active traffic, the man walks away from the camera. He repeatedly turns back to wave and perform a playful skip, his movements rhythmic and lighthearted under even daylight. (8) Inside a brightly lit supermarket, the man is seen carrying a massive, unstable stack of bright red snack bags. He struggles to hold them all while smiling and walking toward the camera through a narrow dairy aisle. (9) Pushing a metal shopping cart down a long supermarket aisle, the man performs a rhythmic side-to-side dance, wiggling his hips. He turns a corner at the end of the aisle while continuing his playful movements, surrounded by shelves of packaged goods.
